def transform(grid):
    # Frame contours become diagonal inward lines: preserve bottom edge, reshape top and sides.
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[[0]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    # Detect rectangular loop and draw its diagonalized left side; top row shrinks to three cells.
    # output occupies same bounding box; bottom remains intact.
    for c in range(c0,c0+3): out[r0][c]=1
    for i in range(1,r1-r0):
        c=c0+2+i
        if c<=c1: out[r0+i][c]=1
    for c in range(c0+2,c1+1): out[r1][c]=1
    return out
